name: EhPanda Beta
subtitle: Try new versions of EhPanda before they're released.
description:
Beta builds of EhPanda, for trying new versions before they're released. Betas may have bugs, and features can still change before release.
Betas often need a newer iOS than the regular version. Please report problems on GitHub.
The beta installs as a separate app next to regular EhPanda. It starts empty and doesn't share downloads, history or settings with it. With a free Apple ID, AltStore can keep only 3 apps at once, including AltStore itself.
Note: EhPanda is not affiliated with or endorsed by E-Hentai.

apps.localizedDescription:
This is a beta build of EhPanda. It may have bugs, and features can still change before release.
The beta installs as a separate app next to regular EhPanda. It starts empty and doesn't share downloads, history or settings with it. With a free Apple ID, AltStore can keep only 3 apps at once, including AltStore itself.
EhPanda is an unofficial app for iOS and iPadOS that allows users to access and explore adult manga and doujinshi from E-Hentai.
With a user-friendly interface, powerful search features, and a vast collection of content, it offers a personalized library and an immersive reading experience.
Note: EhPanda is not affiliated with or endorsed by E-Hentai.
